The '''Darada system''' contained [[Darada]] and was located on the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Jev Sunrider]] was [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] of the system until c.[[4009 BBY]].
